text:
pagerduty-bot: URGENT: Alert for customer `auriga` (dedicated pool auriga-prod-gpu). mTLS handshake failures spiking 504/503s since 02:05 UTC. Affected: ingress to dedicated pool + control-plane requests for token introspection. PagerDuty: P1.

Samir Patel: oncall paging now. I see TLS alert + client errors in the gateway logs. initial error: "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority" from our side to the customer's auth endpoint.

auriga-support: Confirming we rotated our signing cert at 01:58 UTC. Some clients are still using old certs. We rolled the new cert via our CA, might be missing intermediate.

Samir Patel: Copy. This looks like a chain/CA trust issue between our edge and Auriga's mTLS CA. Quick questions: did the cert include the interim chain? Did the rotation touch JWKS keys used for OIDC token verification?

auriga-support: We rotated both server cert and JWKS signing key in the same window. We pushed a cert chain bundle, but our ops noticed an intermediate was omitted from the PEM. We thought it wouldn't matter for mutual TLS verification but maybe it does for some of your nodes.

Priya Rao: I'm on it. Starting by triaging which hosts fail to validate the chain. Samir can you dump the gateway TLS handshake logs and the socket-level error counts?

Samir Patel: Pasting quick grep of gateway logs: 

```
2026-07-12T02:04:58Z edge-01 auriga: TLS handshake failed: remote error: tls: certificate signed by unknown authority (subject="CN=auriga-auth.local")
2026-07-12T02:05:01Z edge-02 auriga: backend connect failed: TLS handshake timeout
2026-07-12T02:05:05Z control-plane auriga: introspection 401 for service-account: token signature verification failed: kid not found
```

Samir Patel: Also a quick metric: mTLS failure rate for auriga-prod-gpu jumped to 32% at 02:05 UTC.

Priya Rao: Thanks. That `kid not found` implies the JWKS rotation timing mismatch. If they rotated JWKS and removed the old key, our cached tokens may be signed with old kid. We need to allow fallback verification using the previous JWKS until their clients rotate. Two-pronged mitigation: 1) re-add intermediate cert to their chain or revert to previous cert bundle; 2) accept previous JWKS key for short window.

Marcus Li: Eng-runtime, FYI: can we temporarily allow stale JWKS keys for auriga dedicated pool? We have per-tenant JWKS cache/override in the control plane; it requires a quick config push but is low-risk if targeted.

eng-runtime: We can push a per-tenant JWKS override that includes both keys. Need approval from security on KYC but since it's a targeted, short-lived mitigation we can proceed. Configuration change will roll out in ~3 mins with 30s gradual window.

Samir Patel: Also need to decide about reloading trusted CA bundles on edge nodes. If auriga re-applies bundle with intermediate, nodes should accept. But we can also add their intermediate to our trust store for dedicated pool only. That is slower (nodes need reload) but would get green quicker than full rollback from their side? Which is faster?

auriga-support: We can reissue the cert chain immediately with intermediate included and push to their endpoint. ETA ~10 mins. If your side can accept the intermediate right now, that would be faster.

Priya Rao: Quick mitigation plan (agreed):
- Step A (fast): eng-runtime to push JWKS override to include previous key (Marcus): TARGET = auriga-prod-gpu only.
- Step B (parallel): auriga to re-push cert chain with intermediate.
- Step C: after cert chain is confirmed working, ripple back JWKS override removal and confirm no stale tokens in rotation.

Marcus Li: Starting JWKS override rollout now. Command: `rtctl tenant-config set auriga --jwks-override /tmp/auriga-both-keys.json --target-pool auriga-prod-gpu`

oncall-bot: Handoff note: Priya Rao is primary until 0500 UTC. Marcus to assist on runtime changes.

eng-runtime: JWKS override deployed to control-plane nodes. Verification: introspection now returns 200 for previously failing tokens. Logs: `introspect success (kid: old-key-1)`

Samir Patel: Nice. I see error rate drop from 32% down to 4% within 90s. Edge handshake errors still around 3-5% — likely clients still failing until chain fixed.

auriga-support: We re-pushed cert bundle with intermediate at 02:15 UTC. Please confirm if your nodes accept it.

Samir Patel: Doing a quick curl test against a backend with client cert: 

```
curl --cert ./client.pem --key ./client.key --cacert auriga_chain_with_intermediate.pem -v https://auriga-backend.internal/health
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* SSL connection using TLSv1.3 / TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: auriga-backend.internal
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

Samir Patel: Health check OK with their re-pushed chain. Edge metrics show handshake failure rate now trending to 0.5%.

Priya Rao: Marking customer impact as reduced: majority of customer traffic restored. Keeping P1 open for monitoring and post-incident verification.

auriga-support: Thanks for the help. We'll keep the old JWKS key available for a 1 hour overlap to ensure clients rotate. We're scheduling a proper postmortem on our side to avoid rolling cert+JWKS simultaneously next time.

Marcus Li: After stabilization we'll rollback JWKS override at 03:10 UTC unless we see regressions. I'll coordinate with Samir.

eng-runtime: Rolling back JWKS override in 1 minute to test.

Samir Patel: Observing introspection logs. Tokens signed with `new-key-2` accepted. No errors.

eng-runtime: JWKS override removed. Control-plane verification: all good.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigation complete, customer traffic restored to normal. Oncall handoff: Priya to Marcus at 0500 UTC.

Priya Rao: I'll take follow-up tasks: create incident ticket, capture timeline, and follow up with Aurora (sic) ops for postmortem. (note: I meant Auriga).

auriga-support: Appreciate the quick mitigation. Please share any logs we need for our postmortem.

Samir Patel: Posting minimal timeline and logs to the incident ticket now. Next steps: postmortem with both teams, add a guardrail to prevent simultaneous JWKS+cert rotations for dedicated pools, and consider adding automated preflight for chain completeness.

Marcus Li: Adding follow-up: add a per-tenant config flag that temporarily accepts a provided intermediate during edge reload to avoid full node restarts. Filed as ENG-RUNTIME-4728.

Priya Rao: Closing this thread for live mitigation. Keeping ticket open until postmortem. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved by runbook step: JWKS override + chain reissue. Incident end time: 02:22 UTC.
